क: 1ká [504], pron. 	—1. interrogative. who, what; used as subst. (76, 7) or as adj. (1817); kim w. instr.: e. g. kiṃ yuddhena, what (is there) with fighting, what's the use of fighting, 4514; so 1719, 249; so ko ‘rthas, 1718; kim w. instr. and gen.: e. g. nīrujaḥ kim auṣadhais, what has a well man (to do) with medicines, 223; so 3221, 5120; ka w. particles: ko nāma, who indeed;  ko nu, who pray; ko vā, who possibly,  181; 	—2. indefinite, both adj. and subst., chiefly in negative clauses and w. the particles [see 507] ca, caná, cid, ápi; --2a. w. mā́: mā́ kásmai dhātam abhy àmitríṇe nas, deliver us not over to any foe; 	—2b. ka ca, some, any, adj. or subst.; kiṃ ca, anything;  w. relative, yāś (ca) kāś ca, (and) what soever, 6810; 	—2c. w. ca na and cana: ka ca na, also or even not any; esp. after a negative: na taṃ śaknuvanti vyāhartum api, kiṃ ca na, can not even speak to him, not even anything, i. e. can not even speak anything to him, 819; so 9621; and so (the feeling for the negation in cana in such collocations becoming lost), ka cana means any, anything, cf. cana; w. relative, soever; yat kiṃcana, whatsoever, 916; 	—2d. very often ka cid: any body or thing; certain, 1811; often w. negative: e. g. 99; 2411 (twice with, twice without); kiṃcit kiṃcid, each a little, 279; w. relative, ya ka cid, whosoever, whatsoever, any soever, 2111; kāni kāni cid, any soever, 8215; 	—2e. ka api, something, somebody, 1711; some, a or an, a certain, 212; na ka api: nothing, 3921; no, no one, 2010; 	—3. derivs of ka, see 505; 	—4. exclamatory, at beg. of cpds: cf., e. g., kā-puruṣa, kim-prabhu, ku-dṛṣṭi, ko-vida, and see 506, 1121e; 	—5. for kim as adv., see kim. [for the stem-forms ka, ki, ku, see 505: cf. Ionic κο-, Attic πο-, in κό-θεν, κῶς, etc., ‘whence, how’; τί-ς, τί, Lat. qui-s, qui-d, AS. hwā, hwœ-t, Eng. who, wha-t; w. katará, ‘which of twain,’ cf. κό-τερο-ς, Lat. uter, AS. hwœ-ðer, Eng. whe-ther, ‘which of twain’; w. ka as indef., cf. τι-ς ‘any one.’]
2ka, m. Who, as name of a god, 9415, 16N.
कंस: kaṃsá, m. metallic vessel; as collective, metallic implements.
कक्षा: kakṣā, f. 	—1. region of the girth; 	—2. girdle, cincture; 	—3. (like French ceinture) circular wall; and so the enclosed court. [cf. kaṅkaṇa: cf. Lat. cinc-tus, ‘girded’; for 1, cf. coxa, ‘hip’; for 3, cf. canc-er, ‘fence.’]
कङ्कण: kaṅkaṇa, n. ring-shaped ornament, bracelet.  [cf. kakṣā.]
कच्छ: kaccha, m. border; shore; marsh-land; the district Cutch.
कच्छप: kaccha-pa, m. tortoise. [‘keeping, i. e. inhabiting the marsh,’ vbl 2 pa.]
कण: káṇa, m. a small grain (as of dust or rice). [cf. kaniṣṭha.]
कण्टकिक्षीरिन्: kaṇṭaki-kṣīrin, m. pl. thorn-plants and milk-plants.
कण्टकिन्: kaṇṭakin, a. thorny; as m. thorn-plant. [kaṇṭaka.]
कथम्: kathám, Vedic kathā́, interr. adv. how ? in what way ? katham etat, how's that ? kathaṃ nu, how indeed ? kathaṃ cana, in any wise soever (emphasizing a preceding negation); katham api, somehow. [ka, 1101.]
कथय: √kathaya (kathayati). tell; talk about; pass. be called, pass for. [lit. ‘tell the how,’ τὸ ὅπως λέγειν: denom. fr. katham, 1058.]
कथा: 2kathā, f. 	—1. story, tale, fable; discussion; 	—2. personified, Story, 569. [prop. ‘the how, τὸ ὅπως,’ 1kathā́.]
कथाच्छल: kathā-chala, n. cover or guise of a fable.
कथाछल: kathā-chala, n. cover or guise of a fable.
कथापीठ: kathā-pīṭha, n. pedestal of Kathā, name of the first book of the Kathā-sarit-sāgara. [2kathā, mg 2.]
कथावतार: kathāvatāra, m. incarnation of Kathā. [2kathā (mg 2) + avatāra.]
कथासरित्सागर: kathā-sarit-sāgara, m. Story-streamocean,  title of Soma-deva's collection.
कद्: kád, interr. pcl. nonne, num; w. cid, nonne, num; kaccid dṛṣṭā, was she seen ? [crystallized acc. s. n. of ka, 1111a.]
कदा: kadā́, adv. when ? na kadā cana, not at any time soever, never; kadā cid, once on a time, one day; kadā cid api na, never. [ka, 1103.]
कद्रु: kádru, a. brown; kadrū́ [355c], f. brown Soma-vessel.
कन्: √kan or kā (caké; ákānīt). be glad. [cf. √kam and √can.]
कनकसूत्र: kanaka-sūtra, n. gold cord or chain.
कनकस्तम्भरुचिर: kanaka-stambha-rucira, a. shining with gold columns.
कनिष्ठ: kaniṣṭha, a. smallest; youngest. [cf. the following words and kaṇa and kanyā.]
कनिष्ठक: kaniṣṭhaka, a. smallest; f. -ikā [1222d], sc. aṅguli, the little finger. [kaniṣṭha.]
कनिष्ठप्रथम: kaniṣṭha-prathama, a. having the youngest as the first.
कनीयांस्: kánīyāṃs, a. smaller; younger. [cf. kaniṣṭha and 4672.]
कन्दर: kandara, n. cave. [perhaps ‘great cleft,’ kam (see ká) + dara.]
कन्दर्प: kandarpa, m. the god of love. [perhaps ‘of great wantonness,’ kam (see ká) + darpa.]
कन्या: kanyā́, f. girl; maiden; daughter. [cf. kaniṣṭha.]
कपटप्रबन्ध: kapaṭa-prabandha, m. continued series of frauds; machination, plot.
कपर्द: kaparda, m. small shell used as a coin, 80 = 1paṇa; -aka, m. the same.
कपाल: kapā́la, n. 	—1. cup or dish, 10213; 	—2. cover or lid, 10416; 	—3. cranium. [for mg, cf. Lat. testa, ‘earthen pot,’ w. French tête, ‘head.’]
कम्: kám, pcl. 	—1. emphasizing the preceding word, 7911; 	—2. interr. pcl., 8810. [ka, 1111a: cf. kád, kím.]
√kam (cakamé; kamiṣyáte; kāntá [955a]; kāmáyate, -ti [10412]). wish; will; desire;  love. [cf. √kan and √can.]
कम्प्: √kamp (kámpate; cakampé; kampitá; kámpitum; -kámpya). tremble or shake.
कम्बुग्रीव: kambu-grīva, m. Shell-neck (i. e. having folds in the neck like a spiral shell), name of a tortoise. [grīvā́.]
कर: 1kará, 	—1. a. doing; making or causing or producing, at end of many cpds; 	—2. as m. the hand (lit. the busy one); 	—3. as m. nomen actionis, the doing, performance, in duṣkara, sukara. [√1kṛ: cf. Lat. cerus, ‘creator.’]
2kara, m. ray, beam. [prob. same as 1kara 2: the rays of the heavenly bodies are conceived as their hands and feet, cf. pāda 4.]
करवारि: kara-vāri, n. water from the hand.
करुण: karuṇa, a. mournful, pitiable; -ā, f. pity.
कर्त: kartá, m. (earth-) cut, ditch. [√kṛt: see garta.]
कर्तृ: kartṛ́, m. doer; accomplisher; officiating priest, 10121. [√1kṛ.]
कर्तव्य: kartavya, grdv. to be done or made, w. the various mgs of √1kṛ. [√1kṛ.]
कर्तव्यता: kartavyatā, f. the to-be-done-ness; -tām brūhi, tell me what I must do. [1237.]
कर्पूरपट: karpūra-paṭa, m. Camphor-cloth, name of a certain washerman.
कर्पूरविलास: karpūra-vilāsa, m. Camphor-joy (lit. having pleasure in camphor), name of a washerman.
कर्मज: karma-ja, a. deed-born, resulting from the actions of a life.
कर्मन्: kárman, n. deed, work, action; sacred work (as sacrifice, ablution); rite, 591. [√1kṛ.]
कर्हि: kárhi, adv. when ? karhi cid, at any time. [ka, 1103c.]
का: √kā (kāláyati). drive. [cf. κέλεται, ‘urges on’; βου-κόλος, ‘cattle driver’; Lat. celer, (like colloq. driving, i. e. ‘hurrying’) ‘swift.’] + anu-sam, lead along after.
कल: kala, a. dumb; indistinct; -am, adv. gently,  and so pleasantly (of humming).
कला: kalā́, f. a small part, esp. a sixteenth.
कल्प: kálpa, m. ordinance, precept; manner, way; etena kalpena, in this way.
कल्मष: kalmaṣa, n. spot, stain; fig., as in Eng., sin.
कल्मषध्वंसकारिन्: kalmaṣa-dhvaṃsa-kārin, a. sin-destruction-causing,  preventing the commission of crime.
कल्य: kalya, a. well, healthy. [cf. κᾱλός, ‘fair’: prob. not akin are AS. hāl, Eng. hale, whole.]
कल्याणकटक: kalyāṇa-kaṭaka, m. n. Fair-dale, name of a place.
कवि: kaví, a. wise, possessed of insight (of gods, esp. Agni); as m. wise man, seer, sage; poet; pl. wise men of old (whose spirits hover about the sun), 9112. [prop. ‘seer,’ √kū, ‘see,’ for *skū: cf. θυοσκόυς, *-σκοϝο-ς, ‘inspecting the sacrifice’; Lat. cav-ēre, ‘look out, be cautious’; Ger. schauen, AS. sceāwian, ‘look,’ Eng. show, ‘cause to look at.’]
कविक्रतु: kaví-kratu, a. having the power or insight (krátu) of a wise one; intelligent. [1296.]
कस्: √kas (kásati; kastá; kāsáyati). move. + vi, move asunder; open; bloom; caus. pass. be made to bloom.
कांस्य: kāṃsya, a. brazen; as n. brass. [kaṃsá.]
काक: kāka, m. crow; --f. kākī, crow-hen; cf. vāyasa, ‘crow.’
काङ्क्ष्: √kāṅkṣ (kā́ṅkṣati, -te; cakā́ṅkṣa; kāṅkṣitá). desire, long for. [desid. of √kam, but reduplicated somewhat like an intens. (1002), *kām-ka(m)-s.]
काण: kāṇá, a. one-eyed; perforated (of the eye), blind.
काणभूति: kāṇa-bhūti, m. Kānabhūti, name of a Yaksha, see 533N. [lit. ‘Blind-luck.’]
काण्ड: kā́ṇḍa, m. n. section; joint of a stalk from one knot to another; arrow.
कान्तार: kāntāra, m. n. great or primeval forest.
कापुरुष: kā-puruṣa, m. miserable man, coward. [see 1ká 4, and 506.]
काम: kā́ma, m. wish, desire, longing; love; at end of possessive cpds [1296], having desire for…, desirous of…; kāmam, see s. v. [√kam.]
कामदुह्: kāma-dúh (-dhuk, -duham, -dhugbhis, etc. [155]), 	—1. a. yielding wishes, granting every wish; 	—2. as f., sc. dhenu, the fabulous Wonder-cow. [for 2, cf. the horn of Amalthēa.]
कामम्: kā́mam, adv. at will; if you please; kāmaṃ tu…na tu, if she please,…, but by no means…, 6412. [kāma, 1111b.]
कामिनीसख: kāminī-sakha, a. in the company of his wives. [see sakha.]
काय: kāya, m. body. [√1ci, ‘build,’ Whitney 43: for mg, cf. δέμας, ‘body, form,’ and δέμω, ‘build,’ and Eng. noun build, as used of ‘a man's figure.’]
कायिक: kāyika, a. corporeal; performed by the body. [kāya.]
कार: kāra, a. making; as m. maker; deed, action; sound. [√1kṛ.]
कारण: kāraṇa, n. that which makes or occasions; cause, 577; occasion; reason; sake, 101; ground for a judgment, 2211. [√1kṛ.]
कारु: kārú, m. praiser, poet, singer. [√2kṛ, ‘mention with praise.’]
कार्तिकेय: kārttikeya, m. metronymic of Skanda, god of war (so called because he was nourished by the Pleiads, kṛttikās): cf. kumāra and svāmikumāra. [kṛttikā, 1216.]
कार्त्तिकेय: kārttikeya, m. metronymic of Skanda, god of war (so called because he was nourished by the Pleiads, kṛttikās): cf. kumāra and svāmikumāra. [kṛttikā, 1216.]
कार्य: kāryà, grdv. to be done, faciendus, w. the various shades of mg belonging to √1kṛ; requiring to be instituted, 419; requiring to be shown; --as n. what is to be done; business; work; matter, 417; affair; duty; emergency. [√1kṛ, 963b.]
कार्याक्षम: kāryākṣama, a. unequal to or unfit for work. [akṣama.]
काल: kālá, m. 	—1. the right or proper or appointed time; 	—2. time in general; 	—3. Time, as the destroyer, i. e. Death.
काव्यशास्त्रविनोद: kāvyaśāstra-vinoda, m. entertainment with poetry and science. [kāvya-śāstra, 1252.]
काश्: √kāś (kā́śate; cakāśé; kāśitá; -kā́śyā). be visible; shine. + ava, be visible, lie open. + ā, look on. + pra, shine out; become clear.
काष्ठ: kāṣṭhá, n. stick of wood; log.
काष्ठा: kā́ṣṭhā, f. race-course; course; track of the winds and clouds in the sky.
किंसुहृद्: kiṃ-suhṛd, m. a bad friend. [see 1ká 4, and 506.]
कितव: kitavá, m. gambler; f. -vī, as a., addicted to gaming. [poss. kim + tava, ‘what of thee ?’ ‘what is thy stake ?’]
किम्: kím, 	—1. as nom. acc. s. n. to ká, see 1ká; 	—2. as interr. adv. [1111a], how ? 738. why ? 1810; 	—3. as interr. pcl.: num; kim aham ajñas, am I a fool ? 3921; an, 7813-, 	—4. in connection w. other pcls: kiṃ ca, moreover, see ca 3; kiṃ tu, however, 2012; kiṃ cana, somewhat, 469; kim punar, how much more (or less) ? 1715. [see under 1ká.]
किमर्थ: kim-artha, a. having what as object; kimártham, as adv. why ? [1302c 4.]
किम्प्रभु: kim-prabhu, m. a bad master. [see 1ká 4, and 506.]
कियद्दूर: kiyad-dūra, n. small distance; -re, as adv. [1116], a little way. [kiyant.]
कियत्: kíyant [451], pron. a. 	—1. how great ? how much ? what sort of a ? 4510; 	—2. (how great, in a derogatory sense, i. e.) not great; small, 461. [1ká or ki, 505, 11722.]
कियन्त्: kíyant [451], pron. a. 	—1. how great ? how much ? what sort of a ? 4510; 	—2. (how great, in a derogatory sense, i. e.) not great; small, 461. [1ká or ki, 505, 11722.]
किल: kíla, kílā [248a], adv. indeed, emphasizing the foregoing word.
किस्: kís, interr. pcl. so at 8810. [1ká, 5042: see 1117: cf. nákis.]
कीर्तय: √kīrtaya (kīrtáyati [1056, 1067]; pass. kīrtyáte). 	—1. make mention of; tell; 	—2. repeat; call. [kīrtí, 10612.] + pari, tell around, announce. + sam, announce.
कीर्ति: kīrtí, f. mention; esp. good report, fame. [√2kṛ.]
कुक्कुर: kukkura, m. dog. [younger form of the onomatopoetic kurkurá.]
कुटुम्ब: kuṭumba, n. household; family; -aka, the same.
कुण्ड: kuṇḍa, n. round vessel; round hole in the ground (for water or sacred fire).
कुण्डल: kuṇḍala, n. ring, esp. ear-ring. [cf. kuṇḍa and 1227.]
कुतस्: kútas, adv. from what place ? whence ? wherefore ? why ? how ? 1917. [1ká or ku, 505.]
कुतूहल: kutūhala, n. 	—1. interest felt in something extraordinary; eagerness; -āt, as adv. [1114b], eagerly; 	—2. interest caused by something remarkable, 5611.
कुत्र: kútra, adv. where ? whither ? [1ka or ku, 505.]
कुदृष्टि: ku-dṛṣṭi, f. a bad or false view; heterodox philosophy. [see 1ká 4, and 506.]
कुन्ती: kuntī, f. Kuntī, one of the two wives of Pāndu.
कुप्: √kup (kúpyati; cukópa; kupitá). 	—1. become moved or agitated; boil; and so 	—2. fig., as in Eng., be angry; boil with rage. + pra, the same.
कुमार: kumārá, m. 	—1. new-born child; boy; youth, 5110; 	—2. The Youth, epithet of Skanda, the eternally youthful god of war --see kārttikeya; --f. -rī́, girl. [cf. sukumāra.]
कुमारदत्त: kumāra-datta, m. name of a man. [‘given by the god Kumāra.’]
कुम्भ: kumbhá, m. jar; pot; urn. [cf. κύμβη, ‘vessel.’]
कुरु: kúru, m. as pl. the Kurus, a people of India; as sing. Kuru, the ancestor of that people.
कुरुश्रवण: kuru-śrávaṇa, m. name of a prince. [lit. ‘glory of the Kurus,’ like Πυθο-κλῆς acct, 1271.]
कुल: kúla, n. 	—1. herd or large number or swarm (of quadrupeds, birds, insects); 	—2. race; family; and so, as in Eng., good family, noble stock. [√3kṛ, q. v.: cf. ākula.]
कुलिश: kú-liśa, m. axe. [perhaps ‘cutting well,’ see 1ká 4, and 506.]
कुश: kuśá, m. grass; esp. the sacred grass, Poa cynosuroides, with long stalks and numerous pointed leaves.
कुशपिञ्जूल: kuśa-piñjūla, n. tuft or bunch of Kuśa.
कुशल: kúśala, 	—1. a. in good condition; equal to or fit for a task; able; clever, 4618; 	—2. as n. welfare, well-being; kuśalaṃ te, hail to thee.
कुशहस्त: kuśa-hasta, a. having Kuśa in the hand. [1303.]
कू: √kū (kuváte). found only w. ā. and perhaps meaning see, look. [prob. for *skū, see under kavi.] + ā, look forward to, i. e. intend. [see ākūta.]
कूट: kū́ṭa, 	—1. n. horn; 	—2. m. n. peak. [for mg 2, cf. the Swiss peak-names, Schreckhorn, Wetter-horn, etc.]
कूप: kū́pa, m. cave, hole; well. [cf. κύπη, ‘cave, hut,’ Lat. cūpa, ‘vat,’ ‘niche for the dead,’ borrowed Eng. coop, ‘vat,’ whence cooper.]
कृ: √1kṛ (Vedic, kṛṇóti, kṛṇuté [715]; later, karóti, kuruté [714]; cakā́ra, cakré; V. ákar, ákṛta [831, 834a]; later, ákārṣīt; kariṣyáti; kṛtá; kártum; kṛtvā́; -kṛ́tya; kriyáte; cíkīrṣati; kāráyati, -te). do, make, in the various meanings and uses of these words; thus, 	—1. perform, 5921; accomplish; cause; effect; prepare, 8315; undertake, 522; commit, 2912; show: e. g. honor, 56; familiarity,  917; compassion, 2119; love, 4218; favor, 5221; contempt, 5416; attend to: an affair, 114; engage in: trade, 4611; a quarrel, 4219; 	—2. do something (good or bad) for a person (gen.), 32, 915; 	—3. make or procure for another, 824; grant; --middle: get for one's self; assume: human voice, 314; take on: form or shape, 483, 496; 	—4. execute; follow: advice, 407; 	—5. work over, prepare: food, 683; 	—6. accomplish; be good for, 185; 	—7. make: a sound, 2617; utter: the syllable om, 608, 9; 	—8. (like Eng. do in don, doff) put in or on; w. loc., 811, 436; set, 10514; w. adverbs: see agratas, amā, āvis, tiras, puras, bahis; 	—9. make a person (acc.) to be something (acc.), 7912; transform into, 4013 ff.; render, w. factitive predicate acc., 188; w. the predicate in composition [1094]: e. g. sajjī-kṛ, make ready, 3417; 	—10. w. adv. in -dhā, divide in parts, 5710; 	—11. do, go to work, proceed, 378; pass. impers., 3016; 	—12. do, esp. sacred work; with karma, 972; without karma (like ῥέζειν θεῷ and facere), to sacrifice, 9312; --see also kṛta. --desid. desire to perform; ppl. [1037], cikīrṣita, that which is sought to be done, intention. --caus. cause to do or make or be done or made; see to it that a thing takes place, 161; pass. tena sa praṇāmaṃ kāritas, by him he was caused to make obeisance, 367; caus. equiv. to simple verb, 265. [cf. αὐτο-κρά-τωρ, ‘self-actor, independent’;  Κρό-νος, an old harvest-god, ‘Perficus,  the Completer, Ripener’; Lat. cer-us, ‘creator’; κραίνω, ‘accomplish’; Lat. creāre, ‘create’: see kratu: orig. root-form,  perhaps, skṛ, 1087d.] + adhi, put over; put in office. + apa, put off; injure, opp. of upakṛ. + aram or alam, see these words. + ā, bring hither, 7410; prepare, fashion, make. + vy-ā, separate, analyse. + upa, bring something to some one; do a service, act as an auxiliary, opp. of apakṛ. [w. the use of upa, cf. that of sub in subvenire, ‘aid.’] + pari, (poss. surround, deck, and so) make ready; adorn. + pra, 	—1. carry forward, accomplish; effectuate, cause; 	—2. mid. set before; put before one, i. e. make the subject of discussion or treatment; w. buddhim, put a plan before one's self, i. e. decide. + prati, work against, counteract. + sam, 	—1. put together; conficere, prepare; 	—2. treat according to the sacred usages, administer a sacrament to, see saṃskāra; consecrate, 1063; 	—3. adorn.

√3kṛ (kiráti [242]; cakā́ra, cakré; ákārīt; kariṣyáti; kīrṇá [957b]; -kī́rya). pour out or scatter abundantly (e. g. hail-stones); cast forth (missiles); strew; cover or fill with. [cf. kula, ‘swarm.’] + vy-ati, pass. be scattered in various directions; be brought to confusion [cf. vyatikara, ‘disaster.’] + ava, strew (loose earth); throw in. + ā, scatter abundantly; cover over, fill; ākīrṇa, bestrown, covered. [cf. ākara, ‘abundance, mine,’ ākula, ‘full.’] + sam-ā, bestrew; cover.
कृच्छ्र: kṛcchrá, a. distressful; troublesome; as n. trouble.
कृत्: √kṛt (kṛntáti, -te [758]; cakárta; ákṛtat; kartiṣyáti, kartsyáti; kṛttá; -kṛ́tya; kṛtyáte). cut; cut off. [cf. kaṭa (for karta, ‘cut, depression in the head,’ i. e.), ‘temple,’ and κρότ-αφος, ‘temple’; Lat. curt-us, ‘docked, short.’] + ud, cut out or off; cut up, butcher.
1kṛt, vbl in cpds. making; doing; causing;  as m. maker. [√1kṛ, 1147c.]
2kṛt, a time, in sa-kṛt. [perhaps fr. √1kṛ, ‘a doing, a time’: cf. kṛ́tu, ‘a time.’]
कृत: kṛtá, a. 	—1. made; done; 	—2. prepared; 	—3. attained, 	—4. well done, and so, good; 	—5. as n. deed; 	—6. (perhaps made, i. e. won) and so, the side of the die marked with four spots, the lucky or winning one; 	—7. the golden age, name of the first yuga, see 582N. [√1kṛ.]
कृतकृत्य: kṛta-kṛtya, a. having one's duty done or end attained.
कृतकृत्यता: kṛtakṛtyatā, f. condition of having performed one's duty. [1237.]
कृतबुद्धि: kṛta-buddhi, a. having a made-up mind, of resolute character.
कृतमौन: kṛta-mauna, a. having a kept silence, silent.
कृतसङ्केत: kṛta-saṃketa, a. having an agreement made, agreed upon as a rendezvous.
कृतसंकेत: kṛta-saṃketa, a. having an agreement made, agreed upon as a rendezvous.
कृताञ्जलि: kṛtāñjali, a. having a made gesture of reverence, with reverent gesture. [añjali.]
कृतान्न: kṛtānná, n. prepared or cooked food. [anna.]
कृतावज्ञ: kṛtāvajña, a. having contempt (done, i. e.) shown to one, disdained. [avajñā.]
कृति: kṛ́ti, f. 	—1. the doing, the production; 	—2. a production, literary work. [√1kṛ.]
कृतु: kṛ́tu, a doing, a time; only in acc. pl. -kṛtvas, and that at the end of cpds. [√1kṛ, 11052.]
कृते: kṛte, as prep. on account of, for the sake of, for, w. gen. [1130] or in composition. [loc. of kṛta, lit. ‘in the matter of’ (cf. mg 5), 1116.]
कृत्ति: kṛ́tti, f. pelt, hide. [√kṛt: for mg, cf. δέρμα, ‘hide,’ and δείρω, ‘flay.’]
कृत्तिका: kṛ́ttikā, f. pl. the Pleiads. [cf. kṛtti: perhaps the constellation was conceived as having the shape of a pelt.]
कृत्य: kṛtya, grdv. to be done; as n. that which ought to be done or is to be done, and so, duty, purpose, end; --f. -ā́, action, deed. [√1kṛ, 963b end.]
कृश्: √kṛś (kṛ́śyati [761a]; cakárśa; kṛśitá). grow lean. [cf. κολοκ-άνος, ‘long lank person,’ κολοσσός *κολοκ-ϳος, ‘colossus’; Old Lat. crac-entes, Lat. grac-iles, ‘lean, slender.’]
कृष्: √kṛṣ (kárṣati; kṛṣáti; cakárṣa; ákṛkṣat; karṣiṣyáti; krakṣyáti, -te; kṛṣṭá; kráṣṭum; kṛṣṭvā́; -kṛ́ṣya). --1. kárṣati: tug, draw, pull; 	—2. kṛṣáti: draw furrows; plough. + ā, draw on, attract; draw from (a source). + ud, pull up, elevate. + pra, draw forward, place in front.
कृष्टि: kṛṣṭí, f. pl. people, folk. [√kṛṣ, mg 2: orig. ‘tillages, tilled lands,’ then ‘settlement,  community.’]
कृष्ण: kṛṣṇá, a. black, dark; w. pakṣa, the dark half of the lunar month, from full to new moon; as m., sc. pakṣa, the dark lunar fortnight.
कृष्णपक्ष: kṛṣṇa-pakṣa, m. the dark lunar fortnight.
कृष्णसर्प: kṛṣṇa-sarpa, m. a very poisonous black Cobra, Colŭber Naga.
कृष्णाजिन: kṛṣṇājiná, n. skin of the black antelope. [ajína.]
कॢप्: √kḷp (kálpate; cākḷpé [786]; kalpsyáte; kḷptá; kalpáyati, -te). be in order; be suitable or serviccable to; help; kḷptá, in order, fixed, settled; --caus. put in order; ordain; arrange; dispose; fix (in the manifold applications of this word as used colloquially). [prob. not akin are Goth. hilpan, Eng. help.] + upa, caus. prepare; furnish; provide. + sam, caus. arrange together; determine;  will; purpose.
कॢप्तकेशनखश्मश्रु: kḷpta-keśanakhaśmaśru, a. having hair and nails and beard in order, i. e. trimmed. [keśa-nakha-śmaśru, 1252.]
कॢप्तान्त: kḷptānta, having its end prescribed; limited. [anta.]
केत: kéta, m. intention; desire; will. [√cit, ‘look, be intent upon.’]
केतु: ketú, m. brightness; pl. beams. [√cit, ‘look, appear, shine’: cf. Goth. haidu-s, (‘appearance, manner,’ i. e.) ‘way,’ AS. hād, ‘way, manner, condition,’ Eng. -hood, -head (as in maidenhood, godhead), Ger. -heit: cf. under maya.]
केवल: kevala, a. exclusive; excluding all else; alone; -am, adv. only.
केश: kéśa, m. hair (of the head); mane. [see kesara.]
केशपक्ष: keśa-pakṣa, m. du. the two sides of the hair of the head; the temples.
केशश्मश्रुलोमनख: keśa-śmaśru-loma-nakha, n. pl. hair of the head, beard, hair of the body, and nails. [1253a.]
केशान्त: keśānta, m. hair-end; long hair hanging down; locks.
केशिन्: keśín, a. maned, with flowing mane. [keśa.]
केसर: késara, m. hair; mane. [written also keśara, cf. keśa: cf. Lat. caesaries, ‘hair, mane,’ but not Eng. hair.]
केसराग्र: kesarāgra, n. ends of a mane. [agra.]
कोटर: koṭara, n. hollow of a tree.
कोदण्ड: ko-daṇḍa, m. bow (of an archer). [‘goodstick, ’ see 1ká 4, and 506.]
कोदण्डाटनी: kodaṇḍāṭanī, f. the notched end of a bow. [aṭanī.]
कोलाहल: kolāhala, m. n. uproar, confused cry. [onomatopoetic.]
कोविद: ko-vida, a. well knowing or skilled. [see 1ká 4, and 506.]
कौतुक: kautuka, n. curiosity, eagerness; -āt, adv. [1114b], eagerly.
कौन्तेय: kaunteya, m. son of Kuntī, i. e. king Yudhishthira. [metronymic, 1216.]
कौरव्य: kauravya, m. descendant of Kuru, i. e. Yudhishthira. [patronymic, 1211: cf. 1208c.]
क्रतु: krátu, m. power, whether of body or of mind or of both: 	—1. might, 7317; 	—2. will, 752; understanding, 805 --cf. dakṣa; inspiration, insight, esp. for sacred songs and acts; 	—3. sacred deed, sacrifice, 167; ceremony, cf. yajñakratu. [√1kṛ, ‘do, effect,’ 1161: orig. sense of word in mgs 1 and 2 was prob. ‘an effecting, a power to do or carry out’: for mg 3, see √1kṛ 12: cf. κρατύς, ‘mighty,’ AS. heard, ‘strong, hard,’ Eng. hard.]
क्रम्: √kram (krā́mati [745d], krámate; cakrā́ma, cakramé; ákramīt; kramiṣyáti, -te, kraṃsyáte; krāntá [955a]; krámitum, krā́ntum; kramitvā́, krāntvā́; -krámya; kramyáte; kramáyati, krāmáyati [1042c2 mid.]). step; go; go towards. + ati, step beyond; excel; overcome. + sam-ati, excel. [sam intens., 1077b end.] + ā, step near to; come upon; attack; overpower. + ud, go out; depart (of the vital spirit); caus. cause to disembark. + abhy-ud, caus. cause to step out. + upa, step unto; approach, 310. + nis, go out. + parā, step forth; advance boldly; and so, show one's strength or courage. [hence parākrama, ‘valor’: cf. kram + vi.] + pari, go around, circumambulate. + para, step forward; set out; start from. + vi, move away or on; proceed; attack boldly; and so, show one's courage. [hence vikrama, ‘valor’: cf. kram + parā.] + sam, come together; approach; enter (a zodiacal sign, said of the sun).
क्रम: kráma, m. 	—1. step; regular progress or order; -eṇa, -āt, gradātim, cf. yathākramam; --2. procedure; method; way, 3621. [√kram.]
क्रमशस्: kramaśas, adv. step by step; gradually; in order. [1106.]
क्रव्य: kravyá, n. raw flesh; corpse; carrion. [√*kru, which perhaps means ‘coagulate, become stiff’: w. kravís, ‘raw flesh,’ cf. κρέας, *κρέϝας, ‘flesh’; w. krū-rá, ‘bloody, raw,’ cf. Lat. crū-dus, ‘bloody, raw,’ cruor, ‘blood’; cf. AS. hrāw, ‘corpse’; Eng. raw, Ger. roh, ‘raw.’]
क्रव्यवाहन: kravya-vā́hana, a. carrying off the corpses.
क्रिया: kriyā, f. action; performance; doings; labor, pains. [√1kṛ, 1213d.]
क्री: √krī (krīṇā́ti, krīṇīté; kreṣyáti; krītá; krétum; krītvā́; -krī́ya). buy, w. instr. [281b] of price. [perhaps akin w. √1kṛ, and so meaning ‘do business, trade.’] + upa, buy. + vi, sell; sell for (instr.).
क्रीड्: √krīḍ (krī́ḍati, -te; cikrī́ḍa, cikrīḍé; krīḍiṣyáti; krīḍitá; krī́ḍitum; -krī́ḍya). play, sport.
क्रीतोत्पन्न: krītotpanna, a. bought or on hand (of food). [utpanna, √pad.]
क्रुध्: √krudh (krúdhyati, -te [761]; cukródha; ákrudhat; kruddhá; króddhum; kruddhvā́ ). be angry.
क्रुध्मि: krúdhmi or krúdhmin, a. wrathful. [√krudh: cf. 1167 and 1231: paroxytone.]
क्रुश्: √kruś (króśati; cukróśa; ákrukṣat; kruṣṭá; króṣṭum; -krúśya). cry out; call; howl. [cf. κραυγή, ‘cry,’ for *κραυκ-η: for γ in place of κ, cf. τήγανον, ‘crucible,’ w. τήκω, ‘melt.’]
क्रूर: krūrá, a. bloody; raw; fig. harsh. [see under kravya.]
क्रोड: kroḍá, m. 	—1. breast, bosom; 	—2. interior.  [for mg 2, cf. garbha 2.]
क्रोश: króśa, m. call; calling distance; AngloIndian a Kos. [√kruś.]
क्रोशमात्रावस्थित: krośamātrāvasthita, a. stationed at the distance of a Kos. [krośa-mātra + avasthita.]
क्व: kvà, V. kúa, adv. 	—1. where ? whither ? kúa babhūvus, what has become of ? 	—2. kva cid: anywhere; in any case, ever, 2720; w. na, never. [1ká, 505.]
क्ष: kṣa, as collateral form of √1kṣi in kṣa-tra, and as vbl of the same, w. the mg ‘abiding, situate,’ in antari-kṣa.
क्षण: kṣaṇa, m. instant; moment; -eṇa, -āt, as advs [1112b, 1114b], instantly. [prob. ‘the time of a glance,’ a shortened form of īkṣ-aṇa, ‘glance’: for mg, cf. Eng. “in the twinkling of an eye,” and Ger. Augen-blick, ‘glance of an eye, i. e. moment. ’]
क्षत्र: kṣatrá, n. 	—1. rule, dominion, power, 8620; 	—2. later, the temporal power, imperium (as distinguished from the spiritual power, bráhman, ‘sacerdotium’); the second or princely caste or a member of it. [from kṣa = √1kṣi 2: cf. kṣatra-pa, ‘governor of a dominion, satrap,’ and the borrowed σατρά-πης.]
क्षत्रबन्धु: kṣatra-bandhu, m. one who belongs to the kṣatra or second caste.
क्षत्रिय: kṣatríya, m. 	—1. ruler, 751; 	—2. one who belongs to the kṣatra or princely caste, a Kshatriya, 5716N. [kṣatra, 1214a.]
क्षन्: √kṣan (kṣaṇóti, kṣaṇuté; ákṣaṇiṣṭa; kṣatá). harm; hurt; break. [closely akin w. √2kṣi, q. v.]
क्षन्तव्य: kṣantavya, grdv. to be put up with or pardoned. [√kṣam, 212.]
क्षपा: kṣapā́, f. night. [cf. σκέπω, ‘cover,’ ψέφας, ‘darkness’: for ψ, cf. √kṣar.]
क्षपाह: kṣapāha, n. a night and day, νυχθήμερον. [2aha, 1253b.]
क्षम्: √kṣam (kṣámate, -ti; cakṣamé; kṣamiṣyáte, kṣaṃsyáte; kṣāntá [955a]; kṣántum; kṣamyáte). 	—1. be patient; endure;  put up with; kṣānta, patient; 	—2. forgive; pardon.
क्षम: kṣamá, a. patient; bearing or enduring; and so, equal to a thing, able. [√kṣam.]
क्षर्: √kṣar (kṣárati, -te; cakṣā́ra; ákṣār [890]; kṣaritá). 	—1. flow; 	—2. liquefy; melt away; and so, perish. [for *skar: cf. ψείρω (*σπείρω) = φθείρω, ‘destroy,’ ἐ-φθάρ-η, ‘perished’: for ψ, cf. kṣapā, kṣíti: for φθ, cf. 2kṣi.]
क्षार: kṣāra, a. pungent; saline. [√kṣā: cf. ξηρό-ς, ‘dry’: for mg, cf. Eng. caustic, lit. ‘burning,’ fig. ‘pungent.’]
क्षि: √1kṣi, with two meanings, ‘dwell,’ and ‘rule,’ attaching themselves to the stems kṣi and kṣáya respectively; thus, 	—1. kṣé-ti, 3d pl. kṣi-y-ánti: abide or while or dwell, esp. in quiet and safety, 7918; inhabit. [cf. kṣití, 1 kṣáya, kṣétra, kṣéma 1, ‘dwelling-place’; ἀμφι-κτί-ονες, ‘dwelling around,’ κτί-σι-ς, ‘settlement.’] + upa, rest on, be dependent on. 	—2. kṣáya-ti: pos-sess, be-sitzen; be master of; rule, 719. [cf. kṣéma 2, ‘possession’;  κέ-κτη-μαι, ‘am master of,’ κτά-ομαι, ‘get.’] [cf. the collateral form kṣa: for connection of 1 and 2, cf. the relation of Lat. sedēre, ‘sit,’ and pos-sidēre, ‘be master of,’ and of Ger. sitzen, ‘sit,’ and be-sitzen, ‘be master of.’]

√2kṣi (kṣiṇā́ti, later kṣiṇóti; ákṣeṣṭa; kṣitá, kṣīṇá; -kṣī́ya; kṣīyáte; kṣapáyati [1042e]). destroy; make an end of; exhaust; --pass. wane; kṣīṇa, ruined, lost; --caus. weaken. [cf. φθίνω, *φθινυω, ‘perish, wane,’ φθί-μενος, ‘dead’: for φθ, cf. kṣar: w. the secondary kṣa-n, cf. κτά-μενος, ‘slain,’ κτείνω, *κτεν-ϳω, ‘slay.’] + apa, pass. be afflicted, suffer loss.
क्षित्: kṣit, vbl. inhabiter or ruler, at end of cpds. [√1kṣi 1 and 2: see 1147c.]
क्षिति: kṣití, f. dwelling, abode, 7918; piece of ground or land; the earth, the ground. [√1kṣi 1: cf. κτί-σι-ς, ‘settlement.’]
kṣíti, f. destruction. [√2kṣi: cf. ψί-σι-ς φθίσις, ‘decay’: for ψ, cf. kṣar.]
क्षिप्: √kṣip (kṣipáti, -te; cikṣépa, cikṣipé; kṣepsyáti, -te; kṣiptá; kṣéptum; kṣiptvā́; -kṣípya; kṣepáyati). dart; cast; throw, caus. cause to fly or burst, 844. + ā, 	—1. throw at; 	—2. fig. (like Eng. fling, make flings at), deride, put to shame, 810; 	—3. draw towards one's self, call out (a person to vindicate himself), 556. + ni, throw down (one's self, one's body). + vi-ni, lay down separately or orderly. + sam, dash together in a heap; destroy.
क्षिप्तलगुड: kṣipta-laguḍa, a. having the cudgel thrown.
क्षिप्र: kṣiprá, a. darting; quick; -am, adv. quickly. [√kṣip.]
क्षीरिन्: kṣīrín, a. milky; as m. milk-plant. [kṣīra.]
क्षुद्: √kṣud (kṣódati, -te; cukṣóda; kṣuṇṇá; -kṣúdya). shatter; stamp upon; grind small.
क्षुद्रबुद्धि: kṣudra-buddhi, m. Small-wit, name of a jackal. [1298.]
क्षुधार्त: kṣudhārta, a. distressed with hunger. [kṣudhā + ārta.]
क्षेत्र: kṣétra, n. dwelling-place, 8717; piece of ground; field. [√1kṣi 1.]
क्षेत्रपति: kṣetra-pati, m. master of a field; farmer.
क्षेम: kṣéma, m. 	—1. abode; place of rest; security; well-being, 618; 	—2. possession; kṣeme…yoge, in possession…in acquisition,  i. e. in the enjoyment of what we have got and in the getting of more. [√1kṣi 1 and 2: for *ske-ma, 1166: cf. Goth. haim-s, ‘village’; A.S. hām, Eng. home, and -ham in place-names; perhaps also κώμη (if for κῴμη?), ‘village.’]
